content.question: Why should the train-test split be applied before random oversampling?
options: To avoid confusion in evaluation, so that replicated minority samples do not leak between the train and test sets.
Because oversampling requires a test set to generate synthetic data.
Because the train-test split balances the classes on its own.
Because oversampling can only be applied to the test set.
content.answer: To avoid confusion in evaluation, so that replicated minority samples do not leak between the train and test sets.
